notes: RocksDB (Facebook LSM-tree) via rocksdict, in-process, thread-safe. Same modelling as LMDB (ordered key-value + hand-maintained index keyspaces, WriteBatch for atomic multi-key writes). Write-optimised (LSM) vs LMDB's read-optimised B+tree. No server, no network, no replication.

strategy.server_log: no server process: the host application logs (Python logging / structlog) — the harness writes results/logs/nslab-*.jsonl
strategy.slow_query: instrument the call site (timing decorator, OpenTelemetry span per transaction)

value.format: text (RocksDB info LOG in the DB dir)
value.rotation: max_log_file_size 50 MB, keep_log_file_num 3, stats dump every 60 s
sample: ** File Read Latency Histogram By Level [default] **

setup.detail: no server: time the calls in the application (decorator / OpenTelemetry span per transaction)
no server: audit in the application

runtime_log_level.detail: no server log level (RocksDB info_log_level is an open-time option; LMDB has no log)
